text: 【中信建投竺劲：上海楼市已止跌回稳 深圳、北京、广州大概率渐次跟上】9月22日，在2026中国房地产企业品牌价值测评成果发布会暨第十六届房地产品牌发展高峰论坛上，中信建投证券所长助理、周期组组长、房地产建筑及REITs行业首席分析师竺劲指出，中国房地产目前呈“弱复苏、强分化”态势。一线城市成交量率先止跌，北上广深二手房价格均上涨，其中上海最稳健：新房与二手房同步去库存，销供比大于1，租金也止跌回升。
text_en: [CSC's Zhu Jin: Shanghai property market has stabilized after declines; Shenzhen, Beijing and Guangzhou likely to follow gradually] On September 22, at the 2026 China Real Estate Enterprise Brand Value Assessment Results Release Conference and the 16th Real Estate Brand Development Summit Forum, Zhu Jin, assistant director of CITIC Securities and head of the cyclical group and chief analyst for real estate, construction and REITs, pointed out that China's real estate is currently showing a "weak recovery, strong divergence" trend. Transaction volumes in first-tier cities were the first to stop falling, with second-hand home prices in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen all rising, among which Shanghai is the most stable: new and second-hand homes are destocking in tandem, the sales-to-supply ratio is above 1, and rents have also stopped falling and rebounded.
